headline: Growth at the cost of margin

highlights: Per (%) -16/-29/-29 12M Avg Val (INR M) 2140 Financials Snapshot (INR b) Y/E March 2027E 2028E 2029E Sales 45.7 60.7 70.0 EBITDA 5.3 8.8 10.4 Adj.
This execution has led to a sharp revenue beat vs. our estimate.
However, due to a spike in import content, EBITDA margin contracted both YoY and QoQ.
valuation: However, we now bake in lower margins in our estimates and arrive at our revised TP of INR1,130 based on a slightly lower multiple of 40x two-year forward earnings (vs. 42x earlier), as margin performance continues to disappoint.
Valuation and view The stock currently trades at 58.3x/42.9x/36x P/E on FY27/FY28/FY29 estimates.
watch: Key developments that could support future growth ◼ DAC approvals of INR2.1t: On 26th Oct’26, the DAC accorded an AoN for ~INR2.1t worth of procurements, including the VSHORADS and strike systems, along with other ISR and naval platforms.
Financial outlook We marginally reduce our estimates for FY27 and FY28 and expect revenue/EBITDA/PAT to clock a CAGR of 42%/67%/37% over FY26-29 on a low base.
